summary: Load/unload time incurred each time a vehicle starts or arrives at the depot.
businessRules: Adds to route time on each depot visit; interacts with duration/shift caps on reloads.

service defines: Specify the time duration, in seconds, needed to load or unload the vehicle each time it starts or arrives at a depot, respectively. Please note that: * The default value is 0. * If throughput.hand…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.max_depot_runs. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Interaction: with max_depot_runs, service accrues per run.
